summary.en: A local-first, model-agnostic desktop workspace for teams of AI agents.
summary.zh-CN: 面向 AI Agent 团队的本地优先桌面工作区，支持多种模型。

description.en: Coordinate AI agents with separate workspaces and permissions. Agents can work in parallel on separate Git worktrees and review changes before merging. Install on macOS with brew install --cask hedeqiang/tap/crewbase, or download a desktop installer from Releases.
description.zh-CN: 让多个 AI Agent 在各自的工作区和权限范围内协作，使用独立的 Git worktree 并行开发，并在合入前互相评审。macOS 可通过 brew install --cask hedeqiang/tap/crewbase 安装，也可以前往 Releases 下载桌面安装包。
